_note: v2 hooks for le Passage des Paquets (ST_paquets, S02_home): a covered stone arcade with a red tile roof and stacked parcels on a rainy day, the parcels street (ST_control seg015-018). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the reflexive verbs; beret color = verb group.

fr_etaler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe spreads out a big map over a TALL tower of parcels: 'Eh, TALL, eh!' (ay-tah-LAY).
fr_etaler_verb.why: TALL → étaler = to spread out (étaler une carte, étaler du beurre). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ay-ta-LAY -> ay-tah-LAY).

fr_entasser_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe piles up a heap of parcels, each with a golden TASSEL (ahn-tah-SAY).
fr_entasser_verb.why: IN TASSEL → s'entasser = to crowd together, to pile up; entasser = to pile up (entasser des cartons). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (on-ta-SAY) -> (ahn-tah-SAY) to match the card.

fr_caler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe wedges a wooden block under the cart wheel and CALLS out: 'Eh, it's steady!' (kah-LAY).
fr_caler_verb.why: CALL → caler = to wedge, to steady (caler la porte); of an engine, to stall. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ka-LAY -> kah-LAY).

fr_coincer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe's hands are stuck fast in a jar of COINS: 'COIN, SAY, help!' (kwan-SAY).
fr_coincer_verb.why: COIN SAY → coincer = to wedge, to jam; être coincé = to be stuck (la porte est coincée). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_bousculer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe jostles past a lady and knocks her umbrella SKEW: 'BOO, SKEW!' (boos-kew-LAY).
fr_bousculer_verb.why: BOO SKEW → bousculer = to jostle, to push and shove; to rush someone. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (boo-skew-LAY -> boos-kew-LAY).

fr_envelopper_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe wraps a parcel in brown paper like a giant ENVELOPE (ahn-vuh-loh-PAY).
fr_envelopper_verb.why: ENVELOPE → envelopper = to wrap, to wrap up (envelopper le cadeau). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (on-vuh-lo-PAY -> ahn-vuh-loh-PAY).

fr_fourrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe stuffs a FUR coat into a big sack (foo-RAY).
fr_fourrer_verb.why: FUR → fourrer = to stuff, to shove (fourrer ses affaires dans son sac); informal. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_cantonner_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe stands stationed like a sentry beside a giant tin CAN (kahn-toh-NAY).
fr_cantonner_verb.why: CAN-TON → se cantonner = to confine oneself, to keep to (il se cantonne à son rôle); cantonner = to station (troops). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (kon-to-NAY -> kahn-toh-NAY).

fr_positionner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe carefully POSITIONS an old camera on its tripod (poh-zee-syoh-NAY).
fr_positionner_verb.why: POSITION → positionner = to position, to place (positionner la caméra); se positionner = to position oneself. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (po-zee-syo-NAY -> poh-zee-syoh-NAY).

fr_centrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sets a parcel right in the CENTER of the round red rug (sahn-TRAY).
fr_centrer_verb.why: CENTER → centrer = to center (centrer le titre). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (son-TRAY -> sahn-TRAY).

fr_devancer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe zooms past the little delivery van on his scooter: 'THE VAN, SAY: I'm ahead!' (duh-vahn-SAY).
fr_devancer_verb.why: THE VAN SAY → devancer = to overtake, to get ahead of; to arrive before. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (duh-von-SAY) -> (duh-vahn-SAY) to match the card.

fr_solder_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe rings his bell and hands a coat from the sale rail to a happy lady: 'SOLD, eh!' (sol-DAY).
fr_solder_verb.why: SOLD → solder = to sell off cheaply, to put on sale; to settle (an account). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_seconder_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SECONDS the postman, carrying the back end of his big parcel (suh-gohn-DAY).
fr_seconder_verb.why: SECOND (a helper) → seconder = to assist, to back up (elle seconde le chef). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (suh-gon-DAY -> suh-gohn-DAY).

fr_relancer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe throws the long stick back for the dog, like a knight's LANCE thrown again: RE-LANCE (ruh-lahn-SAY).
fr_relancer_verb.why: RE-LANCE → relancer = to throw back; to relaunch, to restart; to chase up. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28 (hook lint): respelling (ruh-lon-SAY) -> (ruh-lahn-SAY) to match the card.

fr_injecter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe INJECTS red jam into a doughnut with his icing bag (an-zhek-TAY).
fr_injecter_verb.why: INJECT → injecter = to inject (le médecin injecte le vaccin). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_vaquer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe busies himself VACuuming the wet cobbles (vah-KAY).
fr_vaquer_verb.why: VAC → vaquer à = to go about, to busy oneself with (vaquer à ses occupations). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (va-KAY -> vah-KAY).

fr_decaler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe shifts THE CALLA lilies along the bench (day-kah-LAY).
fr_decaler_verb.why: THE CALLA → décaler = to shift, to move (forward or back), to stagger (décaler la réunion). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (day-ka-LAY -> day-kah-LAY).

fr_ecarquiller_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe's eyes go huge at A CAR KEY in his parcel: 'YAY!' (ay-kahr-kee-YAY).
fr_ecarquiller_verb.why: A CAR KEY YAY → écarquiller (les yeux) = to open (one's eyes) wide, to goggle. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ay-kar-kee-YAY -> ay-kahr-kee-YAY).

fr_pavaner_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe struts beside the peacock as if dancing a stately PAVANE (pah-vah-NAY).
fr_pavaner_verb.why: PAVANE (a proud old court dance) → se pavaner = to strut about, to show off (le paon se pavane). Reflexive: the mirror; être in compound tenses. RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (pa-va-NAY -> pah-vah-NAY).

fr_muscler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe lifts a parcel over his head to build his MUSCLES (mews-KLAY).
fr_muscler_verb.why: MUSCLE → muscler = to build up the muscles of; to strengthen. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_sevir_verb.hook: With a SEVERE frown, Monsieur Verbe cracks down: whistle blowing, finger wagging (say-VEER).
fr_sevir_verb.why: SEVERE → sévir = to crack down, to clamp down; of an illness or storm, to rage (la grippe sévit). GREEN beret = regular -ir (nous sévissons).

fr_chiper_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe sneakily pinches a CHIP from the paper cone (shee-PAY).
fr_chiper_verb.why: CHIP → chiper = to pinch, to swipe (informal; il m'a chipé un bonbon). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_tirailler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe tugs a TEA towel to and fro with a seagull: 'TEA... RYE... YAY!' (tee-rah-YAY).
fr_tirailler_verb.why: TEA RYE YAY → tirailler = to tug, to pull at; être tiraillé = to be torn (between two choices). RED beret = regular -er. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (tee-ra-YAY -> tee-rah-YAY).

fr_delier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe unties the string on his DELI parcel of sausages and cheese (day-LYAY).
fr_delier_verb.why: DELI → délier = to untie, to loosen, to release (délier un nœud). RED beret = regular -er.
ex: Elle délie le ruban du paquet.
She unties the ribbon on the parcel.
